For this purpose, the Bill specifies reviews of decisions to refuse to grant a student visa, and provides that regulations may prescribe reviews of decisions relating to other kinds of temporary visa, whether refusals to grant or to cancel a visa.* > > *The requirement for the Tribunal to make certain decisions on the papers will not apply to decisions regarding permanent visas and reviewable protection decisions.
